findings.title: Mixed HTTP/HTTPS routes and no observed canonical declarations

evidence.observation: All five inspected pages had an empty canonical field, while the HTTPS homepage links to many HTTP product URLs and sampled pages use both schemes, creating avoidable URL identity ambiguity.

suggested_action.summary: Choose HTTPS as the single public URL scheme, redirect HTTP routes, update internal links, and emit self-referencing canonicals.
suggested_action.mechanism: A normalized URL identity reduces duplicate-route ambiguity and gives retrieval systems a stable product destination.

findings.title: A malformed outbound link creates a concrete dead-end risk
